title: Violet Flower Sorceress
description: A luminous purple female figure stands on a stone ledge with eyes closed, her translucent body adorned with glowing golden flowers and cosmic patterns. She extends her hands as a glowing golden-purple flower hovers above her palm, dripping viscous liquid, while petals and droplets fall around her against a dramatic twilight sky with golden light beams.
prompt: A ethereal translucent purple female figure with closed eyes stands on ancient stone, her body covered in glowing golden roses and cosmic swirls. Golden flowers bloom in her flowing purple hair as she magically levitates a glowing purple and gold flower above her outstretched hands, dripping viscous glowing liquid and petals. Dramatic twilight sky with golden god rays breaking through dark clouds, petals falling everywhere, magical atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art
